name: web-dark-navy-top-navigation-bar-variants-with-search-and-profile
title: Dark Navy Top Navigation Bar Variants
whatItIs: Six dark navy rounded top bars on grey-blue: a simple Dashboard title with search and profile, a title with breadcrumb and shortcut hint, a left search with actions, and three versions with the deFransz logo and text links (Dashboard, Analytics, Products, Settings), the Analytics item highlighted in blue as a pill or underline.
whatItMeans: Showing several layouts of the same bar documents choices, and a single blue marks active while the rest stay quiet.
techniques: Six arrangements of the same elements
Blue active state as text, pill or underline
Dark mode toggle icon in each bar

vocabulary.definition: An alternative arrangement of a page header.
A keyboard shortcut shown inside a search field.
A small coloured dot on a bell icon.
